meta.title: A chain to mute and bypass
meta.about: Open it, select the blur, and try Ctrl+B then Ctrl+M. Export the API format each time and compare.

notes.2: Bypass this one and the invert reads node 1 straight. Mute it and the invert has no input.
notes.3: Has one IMAGE input and one IMAGE output, so it bypasses cleanly too.
notes.4: Mute this and the server says the prompt has no outputs.
